outputs.prompt: Standalone text-free medieval RPG text input skin inspired by a fine antique brass frame inset into charcoal. One extremely wide shallow rectangle, about 9:1 aspect ratio, straight horizontal and vertical edges with tiny clipped chamfer corners (not concave, not ornamental). Brass is a single hairline thin strip, delicately aged mottled dark warm brass with subtle metallic highlights and a narrow dark recessed inside bevel. Uniform near-black charcoal center with extremely restrained fine grain, meant for live editable ivory text. No text, icon, fittings, emblems, decoration, extra frame, cast shadow, wood, scenery. Straight-on. Isolated on true transparent background. Fill horizontal canvas with modest margins.
outputs.notes: Trim the standalone output to its alpha bounds and export as 1024 × 84 WebP.
refinements: Replace the four straight chamfers with small concave quarter-circle cutouts. The thin antique brass follows each inward curve. Keep the transparent silhouette, charcoal face, and restrained lighting.
